exposure: Received hepatitis B immunoglobulin and HBV vaccine within 48 hours after birth
cohort: Sixty-four infants and children born to HBsAg-positive mothers who received hepatitis B immunoglobulin and HBV vaccine within 48 hours after birth.
finding: Occult hepatitis B virus infection (OBI) was detected in one infant (1.6%) and immunoprophylaxis failure in another (1.6%) among infants born to HBsAg-positive mothers despite neonatal passive-active immunoprophylaxis.
followup_time: Ranging from 6 to 132 months (median 8 months) after birth
cross-section timing: At least 1 month after the last dose of HBV vaccine and not before 6 months of age (median age 8 months, ranging 6 to 132 months)
